mapper.delete: DELETE FROM fm_task_form_rule WHERE TENANT_ID=#{tenantId} AND PROCESS_DEF_ID=#{processDefId} AND PROCESS_VERSION_NO=#{processVersionNo}
mapper.select: SELECT d.FORM_ID formId,v.VERSION_NO formVersionNo, CONCAT(d.FORM_CODE,' - ',d.FORM_NAME,' (v',v.VERSION_NO,')') label FROM fm_form_def d JOIN fm_form_version v ON v.TENANT_ID=d.TENANT_ID AND v.FORM_ID=d.FORM_ID WHERE d.TENANT_ID=#{tenantId} AND d.STATUS<>'INACTIVE' AND v.VERSION_STATUS='PUBLISHED' ORDER BY d.FORM_CODE,v.VERSION_NO DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fm_form_def d JOIN fm_form_version v ON v.TENANT_ID=d.TENANT_ID AND v.FORM_ID=d.FORM_ID WHERE d.TENANT_ID=#{tenantId} AND d.FORM_ID=#{formId} AND v.VERSION_NO=#{formVersionNo} AND d.STATUS<>'INACTIVE' AND v.VERSION_STATUS='PUBLISHED'
